name: TARDIS XR
author: Xargon
description: The Doctors' Sonic Screwdriver (the 10th's by default) and a TARDIS you can enter. Hold the screwdriver and press A (X on the left hand) or the trigger, or on a desktop Shift + click: it hums and lights up. Held 1.5 s on a TV or any device it switches it; on the TARDIS it sends it away; on nothing it calls a TARDIS, whose door leads to the 1st or the 10th Doctor's console room.
